MASTER SERVICES AGREEMENT — Version A
Effective date: 1 January 2025. Acme Private Limited (Customer) and Beta Solutions (Supplier).
1. Payment. Customer shall pay invoices within 30 days of receipt.
2. Services. Supplier shall deliver the services and monthly reports by the fifth day of each month.
3. Termination. Either party may terminate for convenience with 30 days' written notice.
4. Renewal. This agreement automatically renews for one year unless cancelled with 30 days' notice.
5. Indemnification. Supplier shall indemnify Customer for third-party claims arising from Supplier's breach.
6. Liability. Liability is capped at INR 10,00,000, except for fraud and confidentiality breaches.
7. Confidentiality. Confidentiality obligations survive termination for 2 years.
8. Intellectual Property. Customer owns all work product and Supplier assigns rights to Customer.
9. Governing Law and Jurisdiction. The laws of India apply and courts in Mumbai have jurisdiction.
10. Non-solicit. Supplier shall not solicit Customer employees during the term.
